title: [UI Tests] Grab and Move new UI tests

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The opt-in HID transport, fixed report formats, primary-monitor coordinate contract, key/button release paths, driver ownership journal, and dedicated ARM64 routing were traced against the current revision. The Grab And Move fixtures exercise move/resize, geometry visibility, modifier changes, exclusions, and module enable/disable behavior; declaring those tests is not evidence that the interactive paths have passed.

The bootstrapper requires a valid Authenticode signature after download from its fixed official HTTPS endpoint, and the driver dependencies undergo package-signature verification. A stricter publisher policy could be considered separately, but no accepted unexpected binary was established. The diagnostic helper's actual call sites occur after certificate construction; its implicit script-local dependency does not establish a current provisioning failure.

**Validation scope:** Eight changed PowerShell scripts and seven XML files parsed. Five focused Pester suites passed 203 checks on this exact revision, covering mocked driver ownership, suite selection, image routing, signing selection, and non-elevated launcher contracts. The driver OS commands and certificate stores were mocked.

No driver was installed, no physical input was injected, and no ARM64, interactive Grab And Move, full product build, or real driver-provisioning execution was performed. Those paths remain unverified. No required source correction was established by this focused assessment; this is not an unconditional approval or runtime signoff.

The latest maintainer approval on this unchanged revision is acknowledged. It contains no additional validation result; the execution limitations above remain unchanged.
